abstract: The main findings of the comparison are as follows. Overall, Brostamide improves blood pressure control compared with Standard care. Overall, Alvenor lowers blood pressure control compared with Standard care.
conclusion: Taken together, the arms compare as follows. Overall, Brostamide improves blood pressure control compared with Standard care. Overall, Alvenor lowers blood pressure control compared with Standard care.
section:
### Comparison of the arms

Standard care is the usual blood pressure treatment given to every patient. Brostamide is a water tablet that helps the body clear extra salt. Alvenor is a once daily tablet that relaxes the walls of the blood vessels. The groups in this comparison were followed at the Riverside Pressure Registry.

Table 2. Counts and means for every group, measure and subset.
